evidence.quote: | inductor Q | **Q = 16** | first grid step up | s11 −0.024, idd −0.063 | **better inductors FAIL** (loss was damping the match; RQL2 carries DC). Q = 8/10 PASS with NF margin left (+1.01 at Q=8) |
The design **fails when its inductors get better** (Q 16/20): the match is partly loss-damped and RQL2 sits in a DC path. A hardened point should be re-checked at Q = {8, 20}, not only Q = 12.

rule: Sweep component quality in both directions and re-check any match-critical point at Q = {8, 20}, not only at nominal.

applicability.applies: Designs whose input match is partly loss-damped, or where a Q-loss resistor sits in a DC path -- both are invisible in the nominal metric vector.
applicability.not: One design, one sweep. The direction of the effect is design-specific: here the point IMPROVES at low Q, which means the Q=12 assumption is currently load-bearing in the lucky direction.
